ostrea, ostreae f.

Other words

  • ostreārum vīvārium — an oyster bed

    classical · Plin. NH 9.168: ostreārum vīvāria (Lewis & Short)

    An enclosure where oysters are kept: vīvārium is any preserve for live creatures.

  • ostreārium, ostreāriī n. — an oyster bed

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 143

    Not in Lewis & Short.
